messages:
maria: Hey team, small logistics check 1 3 new hires start next week and the orientation invite says 9:00 AM PT. Can someone confirm the canonical link we should share in offer emails (so we don't send the ephemeral Meet link by mistake)?
onboarding-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orient-main-2025. Recording will be attached to the event and uploaded to Drive: /onboarding/recordings.
kevin: Use the calendar event URL (same as above) as the canonical link. We also publish a one-click short bundle after the session with the trimmed video + slides. I'll post the short link when it's ready.
sasha: Quick timezone note 1 a few new hires in IST and AEST reported their calendars converted 09:00 PT to weird times and created duplicates after importing .ics. Any recommended wording for the invite to avoid that?
ops: Add this near the top of the description: "IMPORTANT: If you accepted this invite in Google Calendar, do NOT import the .ics file. Importing can create duplicate events in Outlook/Apple calendars." Also include a small TZ table and a link to a TZ-fixed .ics for Outlook users.
tz-bot: Converted times for the event start: 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 CET / 21:30 IST / 00:00 AEST (next day).
maria: Perfect. Will slides be posted before the session so managers can prep? Also asking whether we should tell people where to find captions/transcripts.
kevin: Slides + agenda are uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/onboard-2025-orient. Captions and transcript go to Notion and the Drive folder after processing. We'll attach SRTs and a quick-watch trimmed video (20 min) to the calendar event.
sasha: For APAC folks who can't attend, is there a region-friendly replay? If so I'll include that in the offer email.
onboarding-bot: APAC replay event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orient-apac-2025 at 09:00 AEST on 2025-04-12. Invite sent to new-hires@redwood.com.
maria: Thanks 1 last request: can someone produce a one-paragraph copy for offer emails that explains "how to join, what to expect, and where the recording will be"? I'll paste that into offer packets.
kevin: Draft copy: "Join our New Hire Orientation (9:00 PT). Use the main calendar link to join live. Slides and a trimmed recording will be attached to the event and to /onboarding/recordings within 30 minutes. If you cannot attend live, watch the quick-watch and join the drop-in Q&A on Monday. Do NOT import the .ics if you accepted via Google Calendar to avoid duplicates." Feel free to tweak.
maria: Awesome 1 I'll paste and send. If anyone hits timezone import bugs, DM me the event ID and local TZ and @ops will export a TZ-fixed .ics. :thumbsup:
